### Initial data analysis & data cleaning (W7)

*What we did:* We first all took a look at the raw data, and tried to understand what the variables represent. The first thing we notices, what that for some variables (e.g. par_1_rr for CZ) we had a lot of missing values, which were not coded as such. We also relazied that we were eokring with categorized variables, and discussed how to handle this best.

*What worked well:* clearing out the NAs?

*What was hard:* Deciding which variables were relevant for our analysis, it was difficult to limit the scope of the analysis. It didn't make sense to check out all countries, because some had a lot of NAs, but it would also be statistically incorrect to completly ignore them. We also had to discuss how deal with the NAs, and what types of parental leave we wanted to focus on because we were looking at multiple categories for different types of parental leave.
